title: Broken in a year
text:
Broken in a year. I was fairly pleased with this item when I received it. Though it has a lot of plastic parts/fittings it did not seem flimsy to me. This was used at home and indoors only, approximately twice a week. The maximum amount of garments hung on it were 9 - three on each arm in order to keep some air flow. I have a spin dryer so my clothes are not soaking wet/heavy.

I took care on the occasions I had to move it out of the way (it has to be set up in bedroom in this small apt, there is no spare room in bathroom) with clothes on it and never had any disasters. However, a few months ago the plastic tab that holds bottom and top rod did break. I was just having to be more careful if I shifted it around that the poles did not separate while I was looking around for something to take the place of the tab.

But yesterday, with no warning, one of the legs collapsed. The plastic support snapped in a very odd place, not an area where there would be much stress actually. I might be able to drill a hole and slip a thin bolt and secure with nut to save this. Might. Although I would have to wonder what plastic fatigue disaster will be next.

While this price of this item is not very high, I still think it should last more than a year. I am looking around for a regular rack now, I will hate having to keep it set up in this small bedroom all the time but I don't want to purchase this same one again and it seems like it is the highest quality available. Replacing anything other than a truly disposable item after just one year is not acceptable to me.
